bio: Ryan Novoa First-Year Social Committee Crimson Yard Hello! I’m Ryan Novoa, a first-year student living in Wigglesworth. I’m from Phoenix Arizona, though my heritage is Peruvian. I am planning on studying Neuroscience, but outside the classroom I am interested in music and martial arts. I joined the FYSC because having a sense of community helps everyone connect and learn from each other. I am so excited to put on exciting events and make the campus a more vibrant and welcoming place!
